verdict.rationale: A probe confirms developer.nvidia.com (the domain hosting RTX PRO 6000's CUDA/developer docs) serves a live llms.txt file with a real summary, showing some agent-oriented discoverability. However, other agent-friendly formats fail — the docs-as-markdown endpoint 404s and no OpenAPI/agent API descriptors exist — and there's no RTX PRO 6000-specific llms.txt or agent-oriented doc page. Missing for 10: page-specific llms.txt for the product, working .md doc mirrors, and any first-party statement that these are intended for agent consumption.
